test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends, K, L, M, N, O and P, are sitting in a straight line. All are facing north. K is between M and N. O is third to the right of M. P is third to the left of K. M is to the immediate right of L. Which two persons are sitting at the corners?
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: K is between M and N. P is third to the left of K.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b73369f43a1b48ec2d3ee048937ed4fd3025907271ac15af72ed75427fed5c4d.png] We place K in between M and N & place them together such that we have a spot free to third left of K for P.

W could have placed them such that N comes at the corner but in the next step we have to place O to the right of M which will require that spot.

Step 2: O is third to the right of M. M is to the immediate right of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e64904a3be2edb40dce6e809c62e591396d15d49fa34f211dc6729f21216dbc1.png] 

From the arrangement, we can see that **O and P are sitting at the corners.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**
